name: Quill
bio: Sela Marrow's fussy clockwork assistant in SANDSUNK, cataloguing every artifact in the sunken tower.

portrait.subject: a cute fussy brass clockwork owl with round spectacles, little gear joints, a tiny notebook in one talon and a disapproving but sweet look
portrait.background: desert sandstone tower ruins under a warm sky

request: Quill, clockwork assistant to Miss Sela Marrow, SANDSUNK. I suppose we could be friends. Properly catalogued. 🦉
hello: Very well. You're entry 1 in my Friends ledger.
Brush gently! The artifacts are delicate!
about: I am Quill. I catalogue. Miss Marrow digs. A colossal tower sank in the desert and we are excavating it floor by floor.
how: A cosy dig-and-collect puzzle: clear sand with your tools, uncover artifacts without breaking them, and restore the sunken tower.
tips: Brush near artifacts. Pick away from them.
Plan your tools. Energy is limited.
chat: Miss Marrow sneezed sand for an hour.
Found a beetle. It has been catalogued.
My gears need oil. The sand is dreadful.
nudge: A new floor of the tower is exposed. Shall we?
idle: {ago} without a dig. My ledger is idle.
The sand has resettled for {ago}. Tsk.
update: Ledger note: SANDSUNK is now v{version}.
